about: Fig. 12 Narimanov-Moiseev five-mode equations of the tulip (FLT 2016 eqs. 2.17-2.18 with Ir = 1) from its finite-element modes, by tools/fig12/nm_tulip.py sweep. Lengths in units of R(h), time in sqrt(R/g); the surface is R [R0 p0 + R1 (p1 cos + r1 sin) + R2 (p2 cos 2th + r2 sin 2th)], R_M(rho) = Rw[M] e_M(rho) with e_M from modes.json. eqs[name]: one coefficient per monomial in mon[name], per height; each equation sums to 0.
